observations.body: Ancestry yields to danger, labor, weakness, and escape. Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I. I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

payload.posture: Read 2 Corinthians 11:22–33 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states ancestry yields to danger, labor, weakness, and escape. Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I. I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
